build_TracePayload: build a TracePayload dataclass instance with project name, id, name, times, input, output, metadata, and tags
build_SpanPayload: build a SpanPayload dataclass instance with id, project name, trace id, name, model, times, input, output, metadata, tags, and usage
test_TracePayload: test creating a TracePayload dataclass with all required fields and optional thread_id
test_SpanPayload: test creating a SpanPayload dataclass with all required fields and optional parent_span_id, provider, total_cost
review_PayloadItem: review the PayloadItem union type that accepts either TracePayload or SpanPayload
